note: Sample produced by Claude from SYSTEM_PROMPT and this story while building the repo. Regenerate with: python -m ai.generate ai/stories/create_issue.md

test_cases.title: Create issue with valid title and description
test_cases.preconditions: Signed in with write access; repository exists
steps: Enter a title and a description
test_cases.test_data: Title 'Login fails on Safari', body 'Steps to reproduce...'
test_cases.expected_result: Issue is created as #1, state Open, title and description shown

test_cases.title: Create issue with title only
steps: Enter a title, leave description empty
test_cases.expected_result: Issue created with empty description

test_cases.title: Reject empty title
test_cases.expected_result: Issue not created; validation error for required title (API 422)

test_cases.title: Reject whitespace-only title
steps: Enter only spaces or a tab as title
Submit via UI and via POST /issues
test_cases.expected_result: Rejected in UI and API (422); no issue with blank title is stored

test_cases.title: Title at maximum length 255
steps: Create an issue with a 255-character title
test_cases.expected_result: Issue created; stored title equals input exactly

test_cases.title: Title one over maximum (256)
steps: POST an issue with a 256-character title
test_cases.expected_result: Request rejected with 422; title not truncated silently

test_cases.title: Title of one character
test_cases.expected_result: Issue created

test_cases.title: Issue numbers are sequential per repository
test_cases.expected_result: Issues numbered 1, 2, 3

test_cases.title: Numbering is independent between repositories
steps: Create an issue in repo A
Create an issue in repo B
test_cases.expected_result: Both issues are #1 in their own repository

test_cases.title: Anonymous user cannot create issue
test_cases.expected_result: 401 Unauthorized; no issue created

test_cases.title: User without write access cannot create issue in private repo
test_cases.preconditions: Signed in as user with no access to a private repo
test_cases.expected_result: 404 or 403; no issue created

test_cases.title: Create issue in non-existent repository
test_cases.expected_result: 404 Not Found

test_cases.title: Unicode and emoji title stored exactly
test_cases.expected_result: Title displayed and returned by API exactly as entered

test_cases.title: HTML in title is rendered as text
test_cases.expected_result: Title shown literally; no script executes

test_cases.title: SQL metacharacters in title
steps: Create issue with SQL injection string as title
test_cases.expected_result: Issue stored literally; database unaffected

test_cases.title: Markdown in description renders safely
steps: Create issue with Markdown and an HTML img onerror in body
test_cases.expected_result: Markdown rendered; onerror handler stripped

test_cases.title: Add a comment to an issue
test_cases.expected_result: Comment appears in timeline; comment count increases

test_cases.title: Reject empty comment
steps: Submit a comment with empty body
test_cases.expected_result: Comment rejected (422); timeline unchanged

test_cases.title: Reject whitespace-only comment
steps: Submit a comment containing only spaces
test_cases.expected_result: Comment rejected

test_cases.title: Close an open issue
test_cases.expected_result: State Closed; closed timestamp set; repository open-issue count decreases by 1

test_cases.title: Reopen a closed issue
test_cases.expected_result: State Open; closed timestamp cleared; open count increases by 1

test_cases.title: Closing an already closed issue
test_cases.expected_result: No error; counters do not change twice

test_cases.title: Invalid state value on update
test_cases.expected_result: Request rejected with validation error

test_cases.title: Filter issue list by state
test_cases.expected_result: Each request returns only the matching issues

test_cases.title: Filter by open state returns only open issues
test_cases.expected_result: Only open issues returned

test_cases.title: Pagination with limit and page
test_cases.expected_result: 2 items, then 1 item; X-Total-Count header is 5

test_cases.title: Page beyond last page
test_cases.expected_result: 200 with empty list

test_cases.title: Invalid state filter value
test_cases.expected_result: 400/422 validation error
